verificationStatus.label: TARA verification
verificationStatus.changed: Changed since the verification on {{date}} — verify again in the Audit tab.
verificationStatus.reconfirm: The verification on {{date}} cannot vouch for the current state — recorded with an earlier TARAflow version, or the file was converted on loading. Confirm it again in the Audit tab.
verificationStatus.outdated: The verification on {{date}} is older than {{days}} days — verify again in the Audit tab.
verificationStatus.failed: The verification on {{date}} did not pass.
verificationStatus.none: Not verified yet — record the verification in the Audit tab.

overviewViews.label: Overview views
overviewViews.methodologyHint: Derived from the project's configuration — the same record the report's methodology chapter uses. Scales, matrix and acceptance criteria are set in the Risk tab's configuration.

itemDefinition.intro: What is analysed: the item (ISO/SAE 21434 9.3), its boundary, functions, preliminary architecture and operational environment. Describe it here or refer to the architecture document it comes from.

purpose.title: Purpose and functions
purpose.hint: What the item is for and what it does — the former project description.
purpose.placeholder: Describe the item's purpose and its main functions...

boundary.title: Item boundary
boundary.hint: What belongs to the item and what does not; its interfaces to other items and to the environment (9.3 a).

architecture.title: Preliminary architecture
architecture.hint: The item's main building blocks and how they work together (9.3 c) — refer to the DFD instead of redrawing it.

environment.title: Operational environment
environment.hint: Where and how the item is used, as far as relevant to cybersecurity (9.3, RQ-09-02).

constraints.title: Constraints and legal requirements
constraints.hint: Technical, organisational and legal constraints the analysis has to respect.

functions.title: Functions over the lifecycle
functions.hint: The item's functions and the lifecycle phases they are active in (ISO/SAE 21434 9.3 b).
functions.name: Function

assumptions.title: Assumptions
assumptions.hint: What the analysis assumes about the environment (9.3, RQ-09-02 NOTE 8). Trust boundaries link them; an invalid assumption flags every boundary that relies on it.

findings.purposeMissing: Purpose and functions are not described.
findings.assumptionInvalidInUse: {{assumption}} is invalid but still relied on by {{boundaries}} — review them.
findings.assumptionReviewDue: {{assumption}} is still open after its review date.

neutral.intro: What is analysed: the system, its boundary, functions, architecture and operational environment — for the CRA the intended purpose and the description of the product. Describe it here or refer to the architecture document it comes from.

purpose.hint: What the system is for and what it does (intended purpose) — the former project description.
purpose.placeholder: Describe the system's intended purpose and its main functions...

boundary.title: System boundary
boundary.hint: What belongs to the system and what does not; its interfaces to other systems and to the environment.

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.hint: The system's main building blocks and how they work together — refer to the DFD instead of redrawing it.

environment.hint: Where and how the system is used, as far as relevant to cybersecurity.

functions.hint: The system's functions and the lifecycle phases they are active in.

assumptions.hint: What the analysis assumes about the environment. Trust boundaries link them; an invalid assumption flags every boundary that relies on it.

projectScope.title: Project Source Reference
projectScope.description: The repository and release this TARA was performed against. An analysis reference for the whole project — it is not automatically applied to individual elements.

sourceBinding.localPathWarning: This looks like a local path — only the remote URL is stored.
sourceBinding.notResolvedYet: Not yet resolved to a commit.

resolveError.refNotFound: Reached the repository, but "{{ref}}" was not found there.

consent.title: Allow network access?
consent.body: TARAflow wants to contact the following host to resolve a source reference:
consent.scope: This asks once per host for this session — other bindings on the same host won't ask again until TARAflow restarts.
